statement: RunPod listed B300 288 GB on-demand cloud capacity at $6.94 per hour on Community Cloud and $7.39 per hour on Secure Cloud as observed on 2026-07-29.
why: A published vendor on-demand rental rate for the newest listed accelerator, stated as a level with no baseline or change given on the page.

impact.mechanism: Rental rates set the cost of renting rather than buying newest-generation accelerators; recorded as a display-only price level with no stated direction of change.

confidence.basis: Vendor's own published list price read directly from the live pricing page, but an open-web secondary source with no prior baseline for comparison.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 2.69 -> 6.94 (tol 1%); sources: RunPod pricing page
